verdict.rationale: GrowthBook ships an official MCP server, so AI clients like Cursor, VS Code and Claude can drive it through natural language. The server loads Agent Skills (workflows and guardrails) and makes authenticated REST API calls, which makes natural-language operation feasible, but only through an external AI client. The Cmd+K command palette is navigation rather than natural-language command execution. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language assistant, documentation of which operations the MCP skills cover, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language control works in practice.
